visual_action: Musician John Legend is on stage at a political rally in front of a crowd. He speaks into a microphone, leading the audience in a chant. The crowd behind him holds up blue campaign signs, some of which read "HARRIS WALZ" and "FREEDOM". After speaking, he sits down at a grand piano and begins to play and sing.

cast.name: John Legend
cast.evidence: He is the central figure in the video, shown speaking and performing. On-screen text at the beginning identifies him by name: "John Legend: 'When we fight we win!'"

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: John Legend refers to "our future president" at a rally where signs for "HARRIS WALZ" are visible. The post is from the @democrats account.

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: Campaign signs held by the crowd read "HARRIS WALZ".

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official @democrats account and features a rally for its candidates.

on_screen_text.text: John Legend: “When we fight we win!” 🥶⬇️⬇️

spoken_summary: John Legend addresses the crowd, saying, "Like our future president says, when we fight we win!" He then leads the crowd in a call-and-response chant of "When we fight, we win!" three times. He concludes with, "Let's win, Philadelphia," before sitting at a piano and beginning to sing the opening lines of the song "Glory."
audio_music: The video begins with the sounds of a live political rally: John Legend's amplified voice, and a responsive, cheering crowd. This creates an energetic and hyped atmosphere. At around the 11-second mark, the tone shifts dramatically as Legend begins to play a soulful melody on the piano and sing in a powerful, inspirational tone.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static shot of the performance. The primary editing effect is the use of dynamic text overlays in a bold yellow font that appear and disappear in sync with the key words Legend is speaking.
cultural_references: The song 'Glory', originally from the film 'Selma'
central_claim: By uniting and fighting together, supporters of the Democratic party and the Harris/Walz ticket will achieve victory.
intended_effect: To inspire viewers with a message of hope and unity, and to motivate them to vote for the Democratic candidates.
